metadata.name: Browser
metadata.description: Built-in tabbed browser: the Agent can open, observe, and click web pages under control, fully visible to you in the half-screen drawer

metadataV2.tagline: Keep every Agent web action in plain sight.
metadataV2.longDescription: Built-in managed browser: tabs, address-bar navigation, back/forward/refresh. The Agent opens pages, observes elements, clicks, and types through the narrow browser-engine channel, and every action is shown to you in the half-screen drawer. Only https is allowed (http works for local development addresses); new windows and downloads are rejected by default, and web data stays isolated from the main app.
metadataV2.capability0Detail: Address bar, back/forward/refresh, open in the system browser
metadataV2.capability1Detail: Open pages, observe elements, click, type, and press keys
metadataV2.capability2Detail: Separate web profile; new windows and downloads are blocked by default
metadataV2.caption0: The tabbed browser in the half-screen drawer with the Agent activity bar
